Name: The Very Greatest Wizard In The History Of History

Actions.Name: Signature Spell
Actions.Description:
When you take this Hero Action, you cast one of the following spells. You can't cast the same spell two turns in a row.

Greater Fireball
	A bead of fire streaks to a point you can see, then explodes. Every creature of your choice within a 200-foot radius takes 5d6+30 fire and 5d6+30 radiant damage. A creature can expend a Legendary Resistance to only take the fire damage.

Silver Claw Strike
	You brandish your silvered claws and strike. Make five melee spell attacks (+14 to hit) against any creature of your choice that you can see. On a hit, deal 6d10+15 force damage. Afterwards, teleport to any space you can see.

Hands of Day
	Two clawed spectral hands appear. Choose two of the following effects:
	-Make a spell attack against a creature (+14). On a hit, deal 5d8+10 force damage.
	-Restrain a creature of your choice until the end of its next turn.
	-Gain a +5 to AC and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

Lesser Wish
	Cast any spell of 8th level or lower, ignoring material components.
